CustomField.description: For Course Connections with Role = Learner this field displays the adjusted Course Fee if Course Fee Adjustment is populated; if it is not populated this field displays $0 for MOU or Matriculated fee type program enrollments and displays the Course Fee based on whether the Program Enrollment Fee Type is UC Ad Hoc or Non-UC Ad Hoc, using prices for UC or Non UC set on the Course Offering record.
CustomField.formula:
IF( ISPICKVAL(Role__c, "Learner"), IF( Course_Fee_Adjustment__c > 0, Course_Fee_Adjustment__c,
CASE( TEXT(hed__Program_Enrollment__r.Fee_Type__c),
"UC Grad Student", hed__Course_Offering__r.UC_Grad_Student__c, "Non-UC Grad Student", hed__Course_Offering__r.Non_UC_Grad_Student__c, "UC Post-Doc", hed__Course_Offering__r.UC_Post_Doc__c, "Non-UC Post-Doc", hed__Course_Offering__r.Non_UC_Post_Doc__c, "LMIC", hed__Course_Offering__r.LMIC__c, "UC Ad Hoc", hed__Course_Offering__r.UC_Cost__c, "Non-UC Ad Hoc", hed__Course_Offering__r.Non_UC_Cost__c, "Non-UC, Non-Matriculated", hed__Course_Offering__r.Non_UC_Non_Matriculated__c,
0 ) ), 0 )
CustomField.inlineHelpText: This field displays $0 for learners with an MOU or Matriculated Fee Type on their Program Enrollment unless you populate the Course Fee Adjustment field to override it. If the learner has an Ad Hoc Fee Type this field displays the price from the Course Offering record for UC or Non UC based on the learner's Fee Type.
CustomField.label: Course Fee
